name: obesity due to prohormone convertase I deficiency
description: Prohormone convertase-I deficiency is the rarest form of monogenic obesity. The disorder is characterized by severe childhood obesity, hypoadrenalism, reactive hypoglycaemia, and elevated circulating levels of certain prohormones.
